report.title: How the report workflow works
report.summary: The reusable pieces behind a quick, polished HTML report—from structured content to an optional public URL.

body: Authors choose a small set of proven visual blocks and describe the report as JSON. The renderer places that data inside the canonical HTML engine.
This keeps one-off reports fast to make while preserving the same typography, layout, responsive behavior, and block vocabulary.

steps.desc: Use the visual catalog to select the right patterns.

steps.desc: Replace the sample content and remove unused blocks.

steps.title: Render or publish
steps.desc: Create a local file or upload it with its media.

items.title: Do I edit the HTML engine?
items.body: No. For normal reports, edit the JSON only. The shared engine owns layout and behavior.

items.title: Can a report stay local?
items.body: Yes. Publishing is optional; the rendered HTML is already the deliverable.
